scope: Selected later accounts of Chaupi Ñamca, Checa and Quinti relations, Macahuisa and the Inca, changing rituals, the returning dead, Yacana, and the lake and irrigation huacas (principally chapters 10–31).
editorial_boundary: Original English, audio-first, selectively synthesized telling or analysis of a Quechua manuscript recorded in the colonial context, not an authorized modern oral performance, a translation of the Quechua text, or a complete collation of the copyrighted Salomon–Urioste edition. Interpretive claims are distinguished from manuscript episodes.
